metadata.section: INCREASES IN VARIANCES AND ACCELERATED RESPONSES
subsections: INCREASES IN VARIANCES AND ACCELERATED RESPONSES
metadata.source_title: Evolution and Selection of Quantitative Traits

blocks.content: Contrary to the expectations of idealized long-term response, phenotypic and additive genetic variance can increase during the course of selection, often resulting in bursts of response (Figure 25.8B). As we detail here, a variety of different conditions can lead to such a burst in response, emphasizing just how unpredictable long-term responses can be.
